SessionStart.command: set "A=$(node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/dist/gate.mjs" session-start --from-plugin; printf 'x%s' "$?")$(exit 0)"; held=${1#A=}; code=${held##*x}; ok=${code%%[1-9]*}; reply=${held%x*}; printf '%s' "${ok:+$reply}"; exit 0

hooks.command: set "A=$(node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/dist/gate.mjs" claude-hook --from-plugin; printf 'x%s' "$?")$(exit 0)"; held=${1#A=}; code=${held##*x}; ok=${code%%[1-9]*}; reply=${held%x*}; printf '%s' "${ok:+$reply}"; exit 0
